description: x402 endpoint probe: Sends one unpaid GET to a URL and decodes its x402 payment challenge (v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header or v1 JSON body): version, scheme, network, asset, price in USDC, payTo, resource, Bazaar extension, plus a conformance checklist. Never pays. Source: the endpoint itself. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: status, latency_ms, x402_version, accepts[{scheme, network, asset, amount, pay_to}], bazaar_extension, checks{}, conformant.
